== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Force]] [[madra]] is a specific type of spiritual energy that can be manifested in various forms and applications. It is often characterized by a gray color, appearing as veins, spikes, or even clouds. This energy can be utilized to create physical [[constructs]], such as ghostly cleavers, protective shields, or sharp spikes that approach the properties of [[sword]]-aspect energy. Practitioners can also use it to create pearls or orbs that serve as reservoirs of power for advanced techniques, such as those used to lift entire structures. Beyond defensive or offensive strikes, force [[madra]] can be used for mobility, providing a platform that allows a user to launch themselves through the air with enough momentum to crack space. It is distinct from other specialized energies like life, death, or [[hunger madra]], though it can be combined with different elements through specialized forging and [[binding]] processes.}}
